name: SCOMNET
recent: 公司于11月20日公布季度业绩并宣布派发每股1.2仙的中期股息，除息日为12月10日。同期多名董事及主要股东在闭市期内外申报买卖持股，公司亦进行股份回购。
notable: 宣布2026财年每股1.2仙的单层中期股息。
公布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩。
多名董事及主要股东申报在公开市场交易公司股份。
risks: 董事及主要股东在闭市期内及前后有多笔股份交易申报。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为3388.7万令吉，净利为710.5万令吉，净利率21.0%；营收环比增长14.6%，净利环比增长25.4%；营收同比下滑10.4%，净利同比增长12.6%。

recent_en: The company announced quarterly results and an interim dividend of 1.2 sen per share on 20 November, with ex-date on 10 December.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 1.2 sen per share for FY2026.
Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Several directors and substantial shareholders reported dealings in the company's shares.
risks_en: Multiple share transaction reports by directors and substantial shareholders during and around the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 33.887 million and net income was MYR 7.105 million, with a net margin of 21.0%; revenue rose 14.6% QoQ and net income rose 25.4% QoQ; revenue fell 10.4% YoY while net income rose 12.6% YoY.
